units.translation: not before he had harmed the land: when Antigone said that the honors of Polyneices had been wrongly judged by the gods, the herald says to her, 'In no way were the affairs of Polyneices dishonored by the gods before he had harmed the city, but after he had brought evils upon the city.'

already and long ago he has not been honored and his affairs have not been held in honor by the gods, that is, for a long time he has been neglected by the gods and they paid no attention to him, for they would not have allowed him to be driven out of the land unjustly by his brother; so that now he is also hated by the citizens. In defense against this he says, 'No,' that is, 'he was not neglected by the gods before he brought this land into danger.'
